allOf.description: Stable upper-case identifier such as B1 or B1-SC-LISTING.

postcode.description: UK postcode format, upper case, with the space.

sideMetres.description: The length of the grid square's side in metres (1000 for a 1 km square), not its area.

status.description: 'no-record-in-source' never means none exists. 'stale' keeps the old value and says so. 'not-covered' means the source does not cover the location. 'source-failed' means the lookup failed. Never 'none' or zero.

coverage.description: What the source covers (nation, kind of place), shown with every card.

doesNotEstablish.description: The limit of the real source, in plain words, shown next to the value.

link.description: Where the user can check further, for example the long-term flood risk checker.

source.description: Where a value came from (decisions 0028, 0030). 'label' is the plain-language wording shown to the user.

origin.description: 'plan' marks a value set by the stage 2 plan itself (for example 'not calculated in this version'), not taken from a data source.

documentId.description: Stable upper-case identifier such as B1 or B1-SC-LISTING.

date.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, so a source that only states a year is not given an invented month or day.

allOf.description: Data marked 'synthetic' as its origin must also carry synthetic: true.
Only recorded and stale items carry a value; every gap status must not (rule 7: a gap is never zero, none or clean).

value.description: A stop location (doc 02 section 7). A stop point is not a timetable, frequency, fare or journey time.

distanceMetres.description: Metres. A synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2).

distanceMethod.description: How the distance was measured, for example 'straight-line distance, synthetic'. Required with every distance; a distance is never a walking time.

walkingMinutes.description: Walking minutes, a synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2, register DA-18). Optional; missing is never shown as zero. A walking time is not a distance: it must carry its walkingMethod.

walkingMethod.description: How the walking time was produced, for example 'walking route, synthetic'. Required with walkingMinutes.

value.description: A school from a register: type, phase and location only. Never a quality grade or an admissions promise.

distanceMetres.description: Metres. A synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2).

distanceMethod.description: How the distance was measured, for example 'straight-line distance, synthetic'. Required with every distance; a distance is never a walking time.

walkingMinutes.description: Walking minutes, a synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2, register DA-18). Optional; missing is never shown as zero. A walking time is not a distance: it must carry its walkingMethod.

walkingMethod.description: How the walking time was produced, for example 'walking route, synthetic'. Required with walkingMinutes.

value.description: Inspection outcomes per area with their framework and date. There is no single overall grade field (doc 02 section 7).

schoolItemId.description: Stable upper-case identifier such as B1 or B1-SC-LISTING.

framework.description: The inspection framework the outcomes belong to. Outcomes under different frameworks are not comparable.

inspectionDate.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, so a source that only states a year is not given an invented month or day.

value.description: Recorded crime as counts by category for one month. No rating, score or level of any kind can be stored: additionalProperties is false (rule 4).

counts.description: Counts by category. uniqueItems rejects exact duplicates only; that each category appears once is enforced by AreaDataTests.Area_crimeCategories_areUniqueWithinEachItem.

count.description: Recorded incidents. At least 1: a category with none recorded is left out, never written as zero (rule 7).

value.description: A past sale. Price is whole pence, once. Not a current valuation.

pricePence.description: Whole pence. Decimals are rejected; zero is rejected.

saleDate.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, so a source that only states a year is not given an invented month or day.

distanceMetres.description: Metres. A synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2).

distanceMethod.description: How the distance was measured, for example 'straight-line distance, synthetic'. Required with every distance; a distance is never a walking time.

value.description: A place (the subtype is on the item). A location is not opening hours, availability or whether a surgery accepts new patients. Places of worship also carry 'religion'; no other amenity does.

distanceMetres.description: Metres. A synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2).

distanceMethod.description: How the distance was measured, for example 'straight-line distance, synthetic'. Required with every distance; a distance is never a walking time.

religion.description: Places of worship only, mapped from the source's religion tag (OpenStreetMap `religion=*`; 'multifaith' covers shared prayer rooms, 'other' any faith not listed, 'not-recorded' when the source has no tag). Every faith is shown alike, as the nearest places by distance; never counts, densities or an area's religious makeup (register PD-13).

walkingMinutes.description: Walking minutes, a synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2, register DA-18). Optional; missing is never shown as zero. A walking time is not a distance: it must carry its walkingMethod.

walkingMethod.description: How the walking time was produced, for example 'walking route, synthetic'. Required with walkingMinutes.

value.description: A planning application near the home. Absence of a record is not the absence of an application.

receivedDate.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, so a source that only states a year is not given an invented month or day.

distanceMetres.description: Metres. A synthetic INPUT, never calculated by code (AGENTS.md rule 2).

distanceMethod.description: How the distance was measured, for example 'straight-line distance, synthetic'. Required with every distance; a distance is never a walking time.

value.description: One bus route at one stop: the weekday departure times as published (register DA-18). Times are inputs, never worked out. The reader checks that stopItemId names a transport-stop record.

stopItemId.description: Stable upper-case identifier such as B1 or B1-SC-LISTING.

value.description: An official deprivation rank for one neighbourhood area (register DA-14, decision 0054). A published position, never a verdict on the area.
A published transport connectivity measure for an area, as a position in the published ranking. Not a journey time or a service promise.
The published access figure for the Accessible Greenspace Standard, recorded as an input exactly as published. Never a 'meets the standard' result worked out by us (register DA-16).

publishedFigure.description: The figure as published, with its own wording and unit.

value.description: A published annual mean concentration for one pollutant in one year. A figure, not a rating.
Published council tax charges by band for one local authority and year. The band of a particular home is not known from this.

annualCharge.description: Pounds per year as published, a decimal string.

value.description: A published housing affordability ratio for one area and year. Not a statement about any one home or person.

measure.description: What the ratio compares, as published.

value.description: The published counts of properties in this postcode at risk of flooding from one source, by likelihood category and property type (DA-16), shown as published and never as a single verdict or a yes/no. Category and property type names are as published (to confirm from the download). A postcode breakdown is not a property-level result.

source.description: Which flood source the dataset row is for, as published.

properties.description: The published number of properties: an input, never calculated.

value.description: Published admissions figures for one school and entry year. Not a promise or a forecast of a place.
The published radon potential class for the 1 km grid square around a postcode, as published (register DA-23). Indicative, not a measurement of any home: there is no measured-level or per-home field.

classLabel.description: The class as published (class names to be confirmed from the download).

value.description: The share of premises in a postcode where providers say gigabit-capable broadband is available, as published (register DA-28). Not a speed, not full fibre and not a measured connection.
A link from a postcode to its council, whose private rent caption lives in council-area.json and council-result.json (register DA-29, DA-30). A link only: no pence, period or figure is copied here.
